items.reason: The registered name is 'fluzoparil' ('[DRUG] fluzoparil: a PARP1 inhibitor'), and the exclusion criteria also say 'fluzoparide'. These are spelling variants of the PARP inhibitor whose INN is fluzoparib, and the manual asks for INN spelling. It is the same agent either way, so candidate status is unchanged.

note: This is a naming disagreement only; the post-coding moiety-mapping script should resolve fluzoparil/fluzoparide to fluzoparib. Both coders coded the MGMT requirement ('methylation status of MGMT promoter had been detected or was willing to be detected') as exploratory_correlative. This is inconsistent with NCT05439278, where 'known MGMT status' was coded eligibility; XL may want one convention.
